_: Chrome of the page, in English. Every key is used exactly once in shell.html as {{t.key}} — build.py aborts on an unused key or an unknown one in the shell, so a translation cannot quietly drift away from the markup. Values are plain text: no HTML, no quotes, no angle brackets (they land inside JS string literals as well).
